records.rationale: In app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss, the `.names a` rule changes from `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%);` to `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%));`. This is a concrete change of the light-theme (primary) lightness from 30% to 70%, unlike most other hunks which preserve the original `$primary` lightness in the first argument. This likely introduces an unintended light-theme visual regression for that link.
